hero.title: FishingTrack
hero.subtitle: Track Every Fishing Adventure
hero.description: Record every fishing session, save your favourite fishing spots and securely synchronize your data across all your devices.

features.title: Designed for Every Fishing Adventure
features.subtitle: Everything you need to remember every fishing trip.

spots.title: Everything you need to remember every trip
spots.description: Each fishing session automatically stores GPS location, weather, water temperature, wind, atmospheric pressure, moon phase and your notes. With one tap you can open your favourite navigation app and return to the exact fishing spot.

spotsManager.title: Organize your fishing spots
spotsManager.description: All your fishing spots are saved in a dedicated list. Browse them anytime, edit their information and keep your favourite locations well organized.

session.title: Record Every Fishing Session
session.description: Save location, fishing type, duration, weather, water temperature, moon phase and personal notes to remember every fishing adventure.

cloud.title: Your data is always safe
cloud.description: Back up your fishing sessions to the cloud and synchronize them across your devices. Future releases will also let you manage everything directly from the web.

screenshots.title: Take a Look Inside
screenshots.description: Explore FishingTrack before downloading the beta.

download.title: Join the FishingTrack Beta
download.description: Download the beta for free, explore all features and help us improve FishingTrack before the official release.
download.securityTitle: Why does Android show a warning?
download.securityText: FishingTrack is distributed directly by the developer and not through Google Play. Because of this, Android may display a security warning. The APK is digitally signed and safe to install.
